Closing quote at the end. Examples: Buffer.from([79]) -> b'O' ; Buffer.from([107,212]) -> b'k\xd4' ; Buffer.from('middle','utf8') -> b'middle' ; Buffer.from([186]) -> b'\xba' ; Buffer.from([232]) -> b'\xe8'.
